profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in designing and optimizing large-scale, cloud-based systems for pharmacy billing and insurance claims. Passionate about building scalable, high-performance solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Kafka, and cloud-native architectures.
